pairs.question: Quid ergo refert inter eum, qui in matrimonio gentili a Domino allegitur, et olim id est ante nuptias fidelem, ut non proinde carni suae caueant, cum alter a nuptiis infidelis arceatur, alter in eis perseuerare iubeatur? Cur, si a gentili inquinamur, non et ille diiungitur, quemadmodum iste non obligatur?
pairs.answer: Habet igitur ille perseuerandi necessitatem, hic porro etiam non nubendi potestatem.
pairs.derivation: Objection-and-response structure. Question: dropped the framing tag 'Hoc loco dicet aliquis:' that narrates an objector raising the point; kept the two interrogative sentences verbatim and contiguous. Answer: dropped the framing 'Respondebo, si spiritus dederit,'; the reply then opens with a procedural/deflective preamble ('ante omnia allegans Dominum magis ratum habere matrimonium non contrahi quam omnino disiungi; denique diuortium prohibet, nisi stupri causa, continentiam uero commendat') which states a general principle rather than answering the asked distinction. Advanced the answer start to the operative sentence 'Habet igitur ille...', which directly answers why the one already married must persevere while the other (free before marriage) retains the power not to marry. Ends at the full stop concluding section [8].
